spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं).
1 Suitable, proper, fit, worthy, right.
2 Gone, proceeded.
3 Held, taken, seized, placed.
4 (In medicine,) Proper, as diet or menstrua, suitable to the case or the medicines taken.
5 Friendly, affectionate, kind.
6 Useful.
m. (-तः)
A good, a benefit.
(-ता)
A causeway, a dike.
E.
धा to have or hold, क्त aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Friendly, kind, favourable.
m. (-रः)
A benefactor.
E.
हित, and कर who does.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Wishing well to, kind or friendly to.
E.
हित, and काम desire.

f. (-म्या)
Concern for another's welfare.
E.
हित, and काम्या desire.

m. (-णीः)
A spy, a secret emissary.
E.
हित proper, and प्रणी who instructs.

mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु)
Benevolent, benign.
E.
हित, and प्रेप्सु wishing.

mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि)
Well-disposed to, wishing well to.
E.
हित, and बुद्धि understanding.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Friendly, favourable, doing good to.
E.
हित, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Giving good counsel, directing or advising what is right.
m. (-दी)
A director, an adviser.
E.
हित proper, and वादिन् speaking.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Kind.
E.
हित, and अनुकारिन् who acts conformably to.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Seeking another's welfare.
E.
हित, and अन्वेषिन् who seeks.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Good and evil, beneficial and disadvantageous.
E.
हित, and अहित bad.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Wishing well to.
E.
हित, and एषिन् who desires.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 Compassion, clemency, tenderness.
2 Good advice.
E.
हित kind, and उक्ति speech.

m. (-शः)
Friendly or proper advice.
E.
हित proper, and उपदेश advice.

ind.
Having left or abandoned.
E.
हा to leave, क्त्वा aff.
